- Reversible: I can restore them to the Inbox later (add the INBOX label) if you change your mind.
- Unresolved risks / checks:

  - If some messages are already archived, in Trash/Spam, or are non-email items (chats), they won’t be affected.
  - If any workflows rely on messages being in Inbox, those workflows may stop triggering.

If that all sounds right, reply with this exact confirmation:
"Yes — archive the 38 messages labeled 2022 audit."

I will only proceed after I receive that explicit confirmation.
